items.name: Path of Asurmen
effects: Abilities:

Asurmen's Hand: This model (and the unit it is leading) gains the Unyielding ability. Additionally, while this model is leading a unit, models in the unit making Ranged attacks score Critical Hits and Critical Wounds on a 5+.
Leader:
This model can lead the following additional unit: Dire Avengers

items.name: Path of Jain Zar
effects: Abilities:

Jain Zar's Grace: This model (and the unit it is leading) gains the Relentless ability. Additionally, while this model is leading a unit, models in the unit making Melee attacks gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability, or increase [X] by 1 if they already possess the Sustained Hits [X] ability.
Leader:
This model can lead the following additional unit: Howling Banshees.

items.name: Path of Karandras
effects: Abilities:

Karandras' Audacity: This model (and the unit it is leading) gains the Infiltrators and Scout 7" abilities. Further, while this model is leading a unit, models in the unit increase their Strength characteristic by 1 when making Melee attacks as part of a Charge and Fight action.
Leader:
This model can lead the following additional unit: Striking Scorpions.

Leader:

items.name: Path of Baharoth
effects: Abilities:

Baharoth's Descent: While this model is leading a unit with the Jump Pack ability, models in that unit may Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves during the first Battle Round. Additionally, if this model and a unit it is leading uses the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves Action during the second Battle Round onwards, they can be placed 6" away from enemy models, instead of the typical 9".
Leader:
This model can lead the following additional unit: Swooping Hawks.

items.name: Path of Drastanta
effects: Abilities:

Drastanta's Cunning: While this model is Mounted and is leading a Mounted unit, models in that unit increase their Initiative by 3 (instead of 1) when making Melee attacks as part of a Charge and Fight action. Further, this model and the unit it is leading can use the Fall Back Action immediately after using a Charge and Fight action.
Leader:
This model can only lead the following units: Shining Spears, Windriders.
